Broward's share of its population is also higher (6.64% versus 4.28%), even though Miami-Dade has more total residents. These are ACS 2022 5-year estimates, which carry margins of error.
response.interpretation: Read "bigger Haitian community by headcount" as the number of residents reporting Haitian ancestry in each county.
assumptions: "High need" (population mode) means the top third of reliable ZIPs in Miami Metro by Haitian-ancestry share: ≥ 5.12% high, 0.84–5.12% medium.
Totals add up the ZIPs assigned to each county; a ZIP crossing a county line counts fully toward the one holding most of its land, so totals differ slightly from official county figures.
Median internet and diploma rates are medians across reliable ZIPs, not population-weighted averages.
